# aiup

> A local catalog for AI tools on macOS.

Local inventory is never uploaded. The public CLI refreshes its runtime and catalog from GitHub before each run; install/update actions may contact Homebrew or the selected vendor.

- Site: https://aiup.neuman.dev/
- Source: https://github.com/travisjneuman/aiup
- License: MIT

Install and how-to live in the GitHub README.
